*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +6 and ATK & DEF 318%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
- Launches an additional attack that has a high chance of becoming
a Super Attack
- Great chance of performing a critical hit
- Receives an additional Ki +3 per Rainbow Ki Sphere obtained
*As the 1st or 3rd attacker in a turn at the start of turn*
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Randomly changes Ki Spheres of a certain Type to Rainbow
Ki Spheres
*Per "Time Travelers" or "Super Saiyans" Category ally on the team
(depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK & DEF 25%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 150%)
- Chance of performing a critical hit 5%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 30%)
*For every Rainbow Ki Sphere obtained*
- ATK 31%{passiveImg:up_g} and damage reduction rate 8%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Recovers 5% HP
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g} and DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every Super Attack performed*
- ATK & DEF 31%{passiveImg:up_g} and damage reduction rate 8%{passiveImg:up_g}
within the turn
*Starting from the 6th turn from the start of battle,
or when HP is 40% or less*
- {passiveImg:once}ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:once}Launches an additional Super Attack
